'''Golden Bokoblins''' are [[Enemy|Enemies]] in {{BotW}}. They are exclusive to ''[[Master Mode]]'', which is part of {{TMT}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack.

{{Terminology
|-
| {{Term/Store|Golden Bokoblin|Golden Bokoblins|Series, BotW}}
| {{BotW}}<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/>
}}

==Characteristics==
{{Compendium/Extract|Golden Bokoblin}}
In [[Master Mode]], Golden Bokoblins are the strongest variation of [[Bokoblin]], appearing once [[Enemy Progression]] reaches its final level. They are said to be [[Silver Bokoblin]]s that were struck by [[Lightning]], resulting in a mysterious transformation.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> Due to this, they are resilient to [[Electricity|Electric]] attacks, such as those from [[Shock Arrow]]s or [[Thunderblade]]s.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/>

Golden Bokoblins equip strong [[Weapon]]s, typically pieces of [[Bokoblin Gear]] that have various bonuses. When defeated, they may drop [[Bokoblin Horn]]s, [[Bokoblin Fang]]s, [[Bokoblin Guts]], and [[Gem]]s such as [[Amber]]s, [[Opal]]s, [[Topaz]]es, [[Ruby|Rubies]], [[Sapphire]]s, and [[Diamond]]s.
